oneLiner: 物体在平衡位置附近往复运动，回复力与位移成正比、方向相反。
oneLinerEn: Oscillation about equilibrium with restoring force proportional to displacement.
detail: 判据只有一条：回复力与相对平衡位置的位移成正比且方向相反，写成 F=−kx，于是 a=−(k/m)x，位移随时间按正弦走 x=A sin(ωt+φ)，其中 ω=2π/T=2πf。跟着有 v=Aω cos(ωt+φ) 与 a=−Aω² sin(ωt+φ)，三者同频而相位各异：过平衡位置时位移为零而速度取最大值 Aω，到端点时速度为零而加速度取最大值 Aω²——把“位移最大处速度加速度也最大”当成理所当然，是最常见的错读。描述一场振动只需三个数：振幅 A、周期 T（或频率 f）、相位 φ；相位讲某一刻在周期里走到哪一处，两振子相位差恒为零叫同相、恒为 π 叫反相。两个原型各有各的ω：弹簧振子 ω=√(k/m)，取 k=100 牛每米、m=0.25 千克得 ω=20 弧度每秒、周期约 0.31 秒，与质量有关而与振幅无关；单摆在小角度下才近似简谐，因为回复力 mg sinθ≈mg·x/L 才正比于位移，于是 ω=√(g/L)。小角度是前提而非细节：摆角 30 度时周期已比小角公式长约 2%，所谓等时性只是近似，这一步的理想化正是「理想模型」条讲的那类操作。能量账由「机械能守恒」接管：总能为 ½kA²，动能与势能彼此互换而总和不变，A=5 厘米、k=100 牛每米即 0.125 焦；振幅由初始条件定，周期不受振幅影响，这是等时性的另一面。给个量级感觉：标准音 A4 每秒全振动 440 次、端点振幅只有一毫米，末速度约 2.8 米每秒而加速度峰值达七千多米每平方秒、合七八百个重力加速度——指尖摸上去只觉得“微微发麻”而非“看得见振动”，正因为振幅极小而加速度极大。有阻尼时振幅按指数包络衰减、周期略为变长，无阻尼是其理想极限；要把这些量读准，请配合「波动图象与振动图象」一条，那里专讲快照与历史两种图怎么分。计时口径与秒摆、摆钟的调节则归「周期与频率」条。
detailEn: The criterion is a single line: the restoring force is proportional to the displacement from equilibrium and points back at it, F=−kx, hence a=−(k/m)x and x=A sin(ωt+φ) with ω=2π/T=2πf. Then v=Aω cos(ωt+φ) and a=−Aω² sin(ωt+φ): the three share one frequency but differ in phase. At the equilibrium point the displacement is zero while the speed is at its maximum Aω; at the endpoints the speed vanishes while the acceleration reaches Aω². Reading the curve as if everything peaks together is the most common mistake. Three numbers describe a whole oscillation: amplitude A, period T (or frequency f) and phase φ, the last of which says where the cycle currently stands—two oscillators with a constant zero phase difference are in phase, with π they are in antiphase. Each prototype brings its own ω. A spring oscillator gives ω=√(k/m): with k=100 N/m and m=0.25 kg that is 20 rad/s and a period of about 0.31 s, fixed by mass and stiffness and not by amplitude. A pendulum is only approximately simple harmonic at small angles, because only then does mg sinθ≈mg·x/L hold, giving ω=√(g/L); at 30° the period already exceeds the small-angle formula by roughly 2%, so isochronism is an approximation, and that idealisation is exactly the move described in the Ideal Model entry. The energy bookkeeping belongs to Mechanical Energy Conservation: total energy is ½kA², exchanged between kinetic and potential while the sum holds—0.125 J for A=5 cm and k=100 N/m. Amplitude comes from the initial conditions while the period does not, which is the other face of isochronism. For scale: standard pitch A4 runs 440 cycles a second with an endpoint excursion of just a millimetre, so the tip speed is about 2.8 m/s while peak acceleration passes 7000 m/s², some 700 to 800 times gravity. A finger resting on a sounding branch feels a buzz rather than visible motion precisely because the amplitude is minute while the acceleration is enormous. With damping the amplitude decays inside an exponential envelope and the period lengthens slightly; the undamped case is the ideal limit. Read the quantities off the two kinds of graph in the Waveform & Oscillation Graphs entry, and leave timing, the seconds pendulum and clock regulation to Period & Frequency.

oneLiner: 完成一次全振动的时间叫周期 T，每秒振动次数叫频率 f，二者互为倒数。
oneLinerEn: Period T is time per cycle, frequency f is cycles per second; they are reciprocals.
detail: 周期 T 是一次全振动的时间、频率 f 是每秒的次数，二者互为倒数 T=1/f，角频率 ω=2π/T=2πf。单摆的 T=2π√(L/g) 有三层前提：摆角足够小、摆线轻而不可伸长、摆球近似质点；结论是周期只与摆长与当地重力加速度有关，与质量和振幅（小幅下）无关。反解出 g=4π²L/T² 就是实验室测重力加速度的正路：L=1.000 米、测得 T=2.007 秒即给 9.82 米每平方秒，与「重力加速度」条的 9.8 同档。周期太小不好测，实操是测 30 次全振动的总时间再除，这是「微小量放大与转换法」的一个日常版本。历史上 T=2 秒（半周期恰一秒）的摆叫秒摆，摆长 √(g/π²)≈0.99 米，几乎正好一米——米的初议曾取秒摆长，后来走了地球周长十分之一千万的路线；惠更斯 1657 年拿摆做成摆钟，靠的就是等时性。摆钟的误差极好算：周期正比于 √L，摆长缩 1% 则周期短 0.5%，一天快约 433 秒、七分钟；把走准的钟从巴黎搬到赤道，g 由 9.81 降到 9.78，周期变长、每天慢约一分半。1672 年法国天文学家让·里希尔就带着秒摆钟去了南美卡宴，发现每天慢两分半，逼出了“地球在赤道鼓起来”的判断，最终由「万有引力定律」把离心效应与扁率算通。频率与音高是两回事：A4=440 赫兹只是 1939 年定下的约定而非自然常数，音高如何由频率、振幅与波形共同决定，交给「音调·响度·音色」条。电气与生理的量级顺手可比：市电 50 赫兹周期 0.02 秒（与「交变电流」条分工），人心脏约每秒一次、合一点二赫兹。两个易错点：其一，T=1/f 只对周期性运动有意义，一次性的碰撞、衰减振动谈频率要先说清按什么周期；其二，ω 与 f 只差因子 2π，把 50 赫兹当成 50 弧度每秒会错 2π 倍。若只想快速判断“谁快谁慢”，用「数量级估算」条的路子先把周期取整再比。
detailEn: Period T is the time for one complete cycle, frequency f the number of cycles each second, and they are reciprocals, T=1/f, with ω=2π/T=2πf. The pendulum formula T=2π√(L/g) rests on three conditions: small swing angle, a light inextensible cord, and a bob small enough to count as a point mass. Its sting is that the period depends only on length and local gravity—neither on mass nor, for small swings, on amplitude. Inverting gives g=4π²L/T², the standard classroom route to gravity: L=1.000 m with T=2.007 s yields 9.82 m/s², the same band as the Gravitational Acceleration entry. A single period is too short to time well, so labs measure thirty oscillations and divide—everyday use of the Enlarging Tiny Quantities method. A pendulum with T=2 s, half a second to each side, was called the seconds pendulum; its length, √(g/π²), is about 0.99 m, almost exactly one metre, which is why the seconds pendulum was once a candidate definition of the metre before the Earth-circle route won. Huygens built the first pendulum clock in 1657 on the strength of isochronism. Clock errors are easy to forecast: since T scales with √L, shrinking the length by 1% shortens the period by 0.5% and the clock gains roughly 433 s—seven minutes—a day; carrying a well-regulated clock from Paris to the equator, where g drops from 9.81 to 9.78, makes it lose about a minute and a half a day. In 1672 Richer took a seconds-pendulum clock to Cayenne and found it lost two and a half minutes daily, forcing the conclusion that the Earth bulges at the equator—later reconciled quantitatively through Universal Gravitation. Frequency and pitch are not the same animal: A4=440 Hz is a convention fixed in 1939, not a constant of nature, and how pitch, loudness and timbre split the work is left to Pitch, Loudness & Timbre. Handy orders of magnitude: mains electricity at 50 Hz has a 0.02 s period (see Alternating Current for that side), and a resting heart beats near 1.2 Hz. Two traps: T=1/f only means anything for motion that repeats, so a collision or a decaying swing needs its cycle defined before a frequency is quoted; and ω differs from f by the factor 2π, so treating 50 Hz as 50 rad/s is a 2π-fold error.

oneLiner: 振动在介质中传播形成波，波速等于波长乘以频率。
oneLinerEn: A wave is vibration traveling through a medium; speed equals wavelength times frequency.
detail: v=λf（等价于 v=λ/T）的来历只有一步：介质每振动一个周期，波形恰好前进一个波长。用它务必先把三个量的分工想明白。频率由波源决定，是“多少赫兹在振”这件事的唯一来源；波速由介质决定，同一种介质里声波的快慢与频率基本无关；于是波长只是两者之商，波源变了、介质变了，λ 都得跟着重算。这条分工解释了跨介质时的行为：光从空气进入水，频率保持 5×10¹⁴ 赫兹不变，速度降到约 2.26×10⁸ 米每秒，波长便由 600 纳米缩到约 450 纳米——「光的折射」那条讲的正是这一步。波速的量级差异极大：声波在空气约 340、水中约 1500、钢中约 5000 米每秒，而电磁波在真空是 3×10⁸ 米每秒，两者差六个数量级；绳上的横波由张紧与粗细定，v=√(F/μ)，张力大一倍快约 41%。若介质里波速随频率而变就叫色散，玻璃对光的色散（见「光的色散」条）与深水表面波同属此类，无色散介质里才有“一个波速通吃所有频率”的干净图像。横波与纵波的区分在于振动方向与传播方向是否垂直：弦波、电磁波是横波，只有横波能偏振（见「偏振」条）；气体与液体里的声波是纵波，靠疏密交替推进，所以声波不能在真空中传而电磁波可以，固体则两种都支持。最容易错的一句是“波随水走”：介质质点只在原地振动，并不随波迁移，水面漂浮物只上下起伏而不下游，波传走的是振动形式、能量、动量与信息。波长的可感知跨度值得记几个数：440 赫兹的声波长 0.77 米，可闻下限 20 赫兹长达 17 米，上限 2 万赫兹只有 1.7 厘米（超声与次声的分界与其应用交给「超声波与次声波」条）；医用超声 5 兆赫兹在软组织里波长仅 0.3 毫米，这正好是它能否出毫米级细节的原因；无线电从千米到毫米跨六个数量级，谱段划分见「电磁波谱与应用」条。最后留个提醒：水波既不是纯横波也不是纯纵波，水质点走的是近似圆周，所以“波=横波或纵波”的二选一并不穷尽一切。
detailEn: The formula v=λf (equivalently v=λ/T) needs just one step of reasoning: in one period the pattern advances by exactly one wavelength. Using it well means keeping the three quantities' division of labour clear. Frequency belongs to the source—it is the only place “how many cycles a second” comes from. Speed belongs to the medium, and in one medium sound's speed is almost indifferent to frequency. Wavelength is therefore the quotient: change the source or change the medium and λ must be recomputed. That division explains what happens at a boundary: light crossing from air into water keeps its 5×10¹⁴ Hz, drops to roughly 2.26×10⁸ m/s, so a 600 nm wave shrinks to about 450 nm—exactly the step made in the Refraction entry. Speeds span an absurd range: sound runs 340 m/s in air, 1500 in water, 5000 in steel, while light in vacuum runs 3×10⁸ m/s, six orders of magnitude up. Waves on a stretched string obey v=√(F/μ), so doubling the tension buys only about 41%. When speed depends on frequency the medium is dispersive—glass dispersing light (see Dispersion) and deep-water ripples both are—otherwise one speed serves all frequencies. Transverse versus longitudinal asks whether the vibration is perpendicular to travel: string and electromagnetic waves are transverse, and only transverse waves can be polarised (see Polarization); sound in gases and liquids is longitudinal, a train of compressions, which is why it cannot cross a vacuum while light can, though solids carry both kinds. The stubborn mistake is believing matter rides along: particles merely oscillate on the spot, a floating leaf bobs without drifting downstream, and what propagates is the pattern together with energy, momentum and information. Worth memorising as scales: 440 Hz sound has λ=0.77 m, the 20 Hz hearing floor stretches to 17 m and the 20 kHz ceiling shrinks to 1.7 cm (the ultrasound–infrasound boundary is handled in Ultrasound & Infrasound); medical ultrasound at 5 MHz has λ of only 0.3 mm in soft tissue, which is precisely why millimetre detail is resolvable; radio runs six orders from kilometres to millimetres, tabulated in The Electromagnetic Spectrum & Applications. One last caution: water waves are neither purely transverse nor purely longitudinal—each packet of water traces an almost circular path—so the two-way classification does not exhaust the world.

oneLiner: 两列相干波相遇时位移叠加，形成加强区与减弱区。
oneLinerEn: Overlapping coherent waves add, giving constructive and destructive regions.
detail: 叠加原理说的是：几列波相遇时，某点的位移是各列波单独存在时位移的矢量和，且各列波穿过彼此后形状、频率、速度都不改，像没遇见过一样。这不是新的物理假设而是波动方程线性性质的直接后果，正因为是“线性”，只有振幅不太大时才成立——海啸逼近海岸、声波强到出现激波时叠加原理就不再够用。相遇会产生图样，但要得到稳定不动的图样必须相干：两列波频率相同、相位差恒定、振动方向一致，缺一不可；普通两个灯泡不干涉，不是因为光不叠加，而是相位差每秒乱改上万次，图样糊成平均亮度。相干之后的判据是路程差：两源同相时，δ=kλ 处加强、δ=(2k+1)λ/2 处减弱；若两源本就反相，这两个判据整体互换——漏看前提是做错干涉题的头号原因。还要分清“加强”指什么：它指振幅相加为 A₁+A₂，那一点仍在剧烈振动，并不是位移永远最大；减弱处振幅只剩 |A₁−A₂|，两列等幅时那一点才几乎静止。能量也没有被消灭，只是被重新分配到别处，整幅图样加起来仍守恒。定量的例子中，双缝条纹间距 Δx=λL/d：取 λ=600 纳米、屏距 2 米、缝距 0.5 毫米，得 2.4 毫米，条纹肉眼可数；装置与历史见「杨氏双缝实验」，光学的干涉衍射总账在「干涉与衍射」。声波因为波长在厘米到米的量级，干涉极好演示：两只喇叭发 1700 赫兹（λ 约 20 厘米）同源信号，在两者之间横走一圈会听到忽强忽弱数处。另一类干涉不需要狭缝：光在薄膜上下两面各反射一次，来回光程 2nt，膜厚取 λ/(4n) 即约 100 纳米（氟化镁 n=1.38、绿光 550 纳米）时两面反射反相而互相抵消，这就是镜头的增透膜，其淡紫反光与肥皂膜的彩色同出一门；肥皂膜彩色常被误当成色散，其实一个靠干涉、一个靠折射随波长变（见「光的色散」）。同一原理也用来检查平面的平整度，标准样板下空气楔的明暗条纹直接标出凹凸。技术侧，主动降噪耳机把环境噪声反相后叠加，在耳道里“减弱”，对低频规律噪声最有效（治理噪声的其余手段见「噪声的危害与控制」）；微波干涉仪用来精确测距，引力波探测本质也是干涉——但那条物理属于「引力波」。
detailEn: The superposition principle says the displacement at a meeting point is the vector sum of what each wave would have produced alone, and that after passing through each other the waves keep their shape, frequency and speed as if nothing happened. It is not a separate hypothesis but an immediate consequence of the wave equation's linearity—and precisely because linearity is what's behind it, it fails when amplitudes grow large: breaking surf and acoustic shocks are beyond it. Overlap makes patterns, but a pattern that stands still requires coherence: equal frequency, constant phase difference and matching vibration direction, all three at once. Two light bulbs do not interfere—not because light refuses to add, but because the phase difference scrambles tens of thousands of times a second and everything washes into average brightness. With coherence the test is the path difference: for in-phase sources δ=kλ reinforces while δ=(2k+1)λ/2 cancels; if the sources start in antiphase the two criteria swap wholesale, and forgetting that premise is the leading cause of wrong interference answers. Be precise about what 'reinforced' means—it is the amplitude that becomes A₁+A₂, so that point still oscillates violently, not a place frozen at maximum displacement; a cancelled point keeps |A₁−A₂| and is truly quiet only when the two amplitudes match. Energy is destroyed nowhere either: it is merely redistributed, and the total over the whole field still balances. A worked number: fringe spacing Δx=λL/d gives 2.4 mm for λ=600 nm, screen distance 2 m and slit separation 0.5 mm—easily counted by eye; the apparatus and its history sit in Young's Double-Slit Experiment, while the optical ledger is in Interference & Diffraction. Sound, with wavelengths in centimetres to metres, makes interference trivial to demo: two loudspeakers fed one 1700 Hz signal (λ about 20 cm) let you walk between them and hear several maxima and minima. Interference needs no slits: light reflecting off the two faces of a thin film travels an extra optical path 2nt, so choosing the thickness λ/(4n)—about 100 nm for magnesium fluoride at n=1.38 and green light at 550 nm—makes the two reflections cancel, which is the antireflection coating on a lens, whose violet sheen and a soap film's colour share one origin. Soap-film colour is often mistaken for dispersion, but one is interference and the other is refraction varying with wavelength (see Dispersion). The same trick checks flatness: bright and dark bands over an air wedge under a reference plate map the bumps directly. On the engineering side, noise-cancelling headphones add an inverted copy of the ambient sound so that cancellation happens inside the ear canal, working best on low, steady noise (the rest of noise control is under Hazards & Control of Noise). Microwave interferometers measure distances with care, and gravitational-wave detection is interferometry too—though that physics belongs to Gravitational Waves.

oneLiner: 两列同向反向波叠加形成驻定波形；驱动力频率接近固有频率时振幅最大即共振。
oneLinerEn: Counter-traveling waves form standing patterns; driving near natural frequency maximizes amplitude (resonance).
detail: 驻波由两列同频、等幅、相向传播的波叠加而成：某些点始终不动叫节点，某些点振幅加倍叫腹点，相邻两节点相距 λ/2，波形停在原地起伏而不前进，能量在相邻节段之间往返而不外传——这是它与行波最根本的差别，行波才真正“把能量送走”。边界把驻波量子化：两端固定的弦必须满足 L=nλ/2，于是 f_n=n v/(2L)，其中 v=√(F/μ)。代个真实数字：吉他有效弦长 0.65 米、单弦张力约 80 牛、线密度 0.4 克每米，得波速约 447 米每秒、基频约 344 赫兹，二次谐波 688 赫兹恰高一个八度、三次 1032 赫兹。由此立刻看出一个易错点：要把音高提一个八度，频率只需翻倍而张力要翻四倍，因为频率跟着 √F 走，调琴时拧过劲就是这条规律在咬手。管子另有规矩：开口管两端都是腹，f₁=v/(2L) 且奇偶谐波齐全；一端封口则封端为节、开口近似为腹，f₁=v/(4L) 且只有奇次谐波。八英尺（2.44 米）的开口管发约 70 赫兹（把管口端的修正算进去接近 65 赫兹，即管风琴记谱的低 C），同一根管堵上一端就低一个八度——这就是管风琴靠音栓换八度的原理。用 256 赫兹音叉在闭管上做共鸣实验，第一次听到明显增强时气柱长约 33.5 厘米，正是 λ/4。音色取决于基频与各泛频的强度配比，那部分归「音调·响度·音色」，而空气中同类现象的叫法与乐器共鸣箱归「共振与共鸣」。受迫振动是另一半故事，也是最容易讲错的地方：稳定下来之后，振动频率等于驱动力的频率而不是系统的固有频率；只有驱动频率接近固有频率时振幅才显著抬升，这条“振幅—驱动频率”曲线叫共振曲线，位移峰值实际略低于固有频率（差 √(1−1/(2Q²)) 因子，品质因数 Q 大时几乎重合），而 Q 越小峰越矮越钝、能量散得越快。阻尼下的衰减也能量级化：一个 Q 约一千的秒摆每摆动一次振幅只减约千分之三，要三十多分钟才掉到 4% 左右，所以大摆钟能走很久。有益共振处处在用：收音机调谐靠电磁振荡的选频（原理见「交变电流与电磁波」）、磁共振成像靠自旋在射频下的共振（见「磁共振成像」）。但有个流传很广的错误解释必须点名：家用微波炉的 2.45 吉赫兹并不是“水分子的固有频率”，微波加热靠的是极性分子在交变电场里的介质损耗，选这一频点是在吸收强度与穿透深度之间的折中，油和糖照样被加热。有害共振最出名的案例是 1940 年 11 月 7 日塔科马窄桥：约 19 米每秒的风让 853 米主跨每分钟扭转约三十六次（0.6 赫兹）、振幅达数米而垮塌；严格机理是气动弹性颤振这种自激振动，而非教科书常说的“风致共振”，但“驱动频率撞上固有频率”这套判词依然适用，士兵过桥改便步走的规矩也依然有道理。
detailEn: A standing wave is made of two equal-frequency, equal-amplitude waves travelling in opposite directions: some points never move—nodes—others swing at double amplitude—antinodes—with adjacent nodes half a wavelength apart. The pattern heaves in place rather than advancing, and energy shuttles between neighbouring segments instead of being carried off; that contrast is the cleanest way to separate it from a travelling wave. Boundaries quantise the pattern: a string fixed at both ends demands L=nλ/2, hence f_n=n v/(2L) with v=√(F/μ). Put in real numbers: a guitar's 0.65 m speaking length, roughly 80 N of string tension and 0.4 g per metre of linear density give about 447 m/s and a fundamental near 344 Hz, with the second harmonic at 688 Hz exactly an octave above and the third at 1032 Hz. Here is an easy trap made visible: raising the pitch one octave doubles the frequency but quadruples the tension, since frequency tracks √F—anyone who cranks a peg too far feels that square root. Pipes follow their own rule. An open pipe has antinodes at both ends, f₁=v/(2L) and the full harmonic series; stop one end and that end becomes a node, so f₁=v/(4L) and only odd harmonics survive. An eight-foot (2.44 m) open pipe speaks near 70 Hz—closer to 65 Hz once the open-end correction is counted, the low C of organ notation—while the same pipe stopped at one end drops an octave, which is how organ stops swap octaves. Resonance with a 256 Hz tuning fork over a closed tube first swells when the air column is about 33.5 cm, one quarter wavelength. Timbre is the recipe of fundamental and overtones, handled under Pitch, Loudness & Timbre, while the same phenomenon in air and in instrument bodies belongs to Resonance & Sympathetic Vibration. Forced oscillation is the other half of the story and the part most often got wrong: once steady, the oscillation frequency equals the driving frequency, not the system's natural one; the amplitude only lifts markedly as the driver approaches the natural frequency. That amplitude–frequency plot is the resonance curve, whose displacement peak actually sits slightly below the natural frequency (a factor √(1−1/(2Q²)), negligible for large quality factor Q), and small Q makes the peak lower, blunter and faster-dissipating. Damping, too, can be put in orders: a seconds pendulum with Q around a thousand loses only about three parts in a thousand of amplitude per swing, needing some thirty minutes to fall toward 4%, which is why long-case clocks run for ages. Useful resonance is everywhere: radio tuning selects through electromagnetic oscillation (see Alternating Current & Electromagnetic Waves) and magnetic resonance imaging works on spin resonance driven by radio frequency (see Magnetic Resonance Imaging). But one popular explanation deserves naming as false: a microwave oven's 2.45 GHz is not 'the natural frequency of the water molecule'. Microwave heating comes from dielectric loss of polar molecules in an alternating field, and the frequency is a compromise between absorption strength and penetration depth—grease and sugar heat just as well. The most famous destructive case is the Tacoma Narrows Bridge on 7 November 1940, where a wind near 19 m/s set the 853 m main span twisting about thirty-six times a minute (0.6 Hz) with several metres of amplitude until it failed; the true mechanism is aerodynamic flutter, a self-excited oscillation rather than textbook forced resonance, yet the working test—driver meeting natural frequency—still governs the lesson, and the old rule of breaking cadence on bridges still stands.

oneLiner: y–x 图看某一时刻所有质点的位置，y–t 图看某一个质点随时间的位移。
oneLinerEn: A y–x graph shows every particle at one instant; a y–t graph shows one particle through time.
detail: 波动图象的横轴是位置，读的是某一时刻所有质点的位置分布，相邻两波峰之间直接给出波长；振动图象的横轴是时间，读的是某一个质点随时间的位移，一次完整起伏的宽度即周期。两图合体再用 v=λ/T 求波速：绳上 20 赫兹、图上量得 λ=0.2 米，波速就是 4 米每秒。判断传播方向常用带动法：先振动的质点带动后振动的质点，把整条波形沿猜测方向平移少许，比出各点下一刻的动向；另一个等价手法是看波峰两侧的“上坡与下坡”，同一时刻两侧质点的运动方向相反。最典型的易错是把 y–x 快照误当成某质点的振动历史——两图形状一样而含义完全不同，横轴一换，读出的量从波长变成周期；反之由振动图推各质点位置时，必须先把所给时刻钉死。斜率的两副面孔也须分清：y–x 图的斜率是波形的陡度，与质点速度无关；y–t 图的斜率才是该质点的速度，斜率为零处质点正停在端点。位移与加速度的关系在两图里同一：a=−(2π/T)²x，故凡是位移最大处加速度必指向平衡位置而速度为零。还有一个“数数”层面的易错：一个周期里质点走完 4 倍振幅的路程，而波只前进 1 个波长，这两个数不相等、也不该拿来互换。多解性最容易失手：若只给 y–x 图上两点间的距离与相位关系，波长可写成 λ=Δx/(n+φ/2π)，n 取任意非负整数，故波速有无穷多解，题目须再加约束（例如“波速小于某值”或“周期大于某值”）才唯一；忘了这层就多解少解全靠猜。方法层面，这两张图是「图象法与函数思想」条讲的两类函数图像在物理里最典型的落地，读图的三步（看轴、看形、看斜率与面积）在那里；而简谐运动的三个量——振幅、周期、相位——的定义与算法在「简谐运动」，波如何靠 v=λf 由介质与波源共同定价在「波长·波速·频率」，本条只解决“图上读什么、往哪传、有几解”这三件事。
detailEn: On a y–x graph the horizontal axis is position, so it is a snapshot of every particle at one instant and adjacent crests hand you the wavelength directly; on a y–t graph it is time, so one particle's history unfolds and the width of a full excursion is the period. Combine them and v=λ/T gives the speed: a 20 Hz wave whose snapshot measures λ=0.2 m travels at 4 m/s along the rope. To find the direction of travel, use the dragging rule—particles that start earlier drag the ones that start later—so shift the whole curve a little along the guessed direction and compare which way matches the observed motions; the equivalent shortcut is to look at the upslope and downslope on either side of a crest, where particles move in opposite senses at the same instant. The classic error is reading a y–x snapshot as some particle's history: the curves look alike but mean different things, and swapping the axis changes what you can read off, from wavelength to period; going the other way, from a y–t graph back to positions, requires fixing the stated instant first. Slopes have two faces too: on y–x the slope is how steep the waveform is and has nothing to do with particle speed, while on y–t the slope is precisely that particle's speed, zero at the turning points. Acceleration reads the same way on both graphs, a=−(2π/T)²x, so wherever displacement is largest the acceleration points back through equilibrium and the speed is zero. A counting trap: in one period a particle covers four amplitudes of path while the wave advances one wavelength—these two numbers are not interchangeable. Multiplicity of solutions is where students lose marks: given only a separation and a phase relation between two points on a snapshot, the wavelength is λ=Δx/(n+φ/2π) for any non-negative integer n, so the speed has infinitely many values and the problem needs an extra bound (say, speed below some value, or period above some value) before the answer is unique; miss that and every solution is a guess. Method-wise these two graphs are the most concrete instance of the Graph Method & Function Thinking entry's two families of plots—read the axes, read the shape, then read slopes and areas—while the definitions of amplitude, period and phase live in Simple Harmonic Motion, and the way medium and source jointly price the speed lives in Wavelength, Speed & Frequency. This entry settles only three things: what a graph gives you, which way the wave runs, and how many answers it admits.

oneLiner: 波面上每一点都可视为发出子波的新波源，各子波的包络就是下一时刻的波面。
oneLinerEn: Every point of a wavefront emits a secondary wavelet; the envelope of all of them is the next wavefront.
detail: 这一作图同时解释了波的反射、折射与衍射：波面上每一点都可视为发出子波的新波源，各子波在前方的包络就是下一时刻的波面。波进入波速较小的介质时，同一波面上各点子波前进的距离按比例变短，包线遂转向法线一侧，由此直接得到折射定律 sin i/sin r=v₁/v₂，而频率保持不变、波速与波长同比例减小——「光的折射」条里的 n=c/v 正是这个比值的水波版；在水波槽里让斜斜的一列波从深水区进入浅水区，肉眼就能看见波前折向法线。它也给出衍射明显的条件：障碍物或孔径的尺寸与波长可比时子波绕得很远，尺寸远大于波长时阴影边界锐利、近似直线传播。这个判据把一句老话变成算术：门宽一米，而可闻声波波长从 17 米到 1.7 厘米，与门同档，所以“闻其声而不见其人”；可见光波长 5×10⁻⁷ 米比门小六个数量级，所以门槛外的影子利落——直线传播本身只是波长趋零的近似（见「光的直线传播」，衍射的定量账在「干涉与衍射」）。声波还有同一机另一件日常事：声速随气温升高，白天上层暖、下层凉，声线向上弯，喊话传不远；夜里地面先凉，上层反而快，声线向下折回地面，所以深夜听得见远处车声（温度梯度与声速的分工见「声速」条）。原原理只定出波面的几何位置，不回答各方向分配多少能量，后由菲涅耳补上子波的相干叠加、再由基尔霍夫给出严格的衍射积分，才成为可定量使用的惠更斯–菲涅耳原理；今天它并不是一条独立的假设，而是波动方程解的一种等价表示，球面波的二阶包络仍是球面这一事实对机械波、电磁波、水波通用。史的一面值得记：惠更斯 1690 年在《光论》里用这套子波说解释反射与折射，与牛顿的微粒说对峙百余年，直到 1801 年杨氏双缝把波动说推上台面；而折射率与光速的关系也由这同一套图像顺带给出——这些都归「杨氏双缝实验」与光学各条，本条只留“波面如何一格一格往前推进”这个作图本身，以及它的适用边界：介质均匀、波速已知、且波长与障碍物尺寸之比决定图样粗细。
detailEn: The construction explains reflection, refraction and diffraction at once: every point of a wavefront acts as a source of secondary wavelets, and the envelope of all of them ahead is the next wavefront. Entering a slower medium shortens every wavelet on the same front in the same proportion, tilting the envelope toward the normal, which yields the sine law directly as sin i/sin r=v₁/v₂ while frequency holds and speed and wavelength shrink together—the n=c/v of the Refraction entry is this ratio in its optical dress. In a ripple tank a train of waves slanting from deep to shallow water visibly bends its fronts toward the normal. The construction also states when diffraction matters: an obstacle or aperture comparable to the wavelength gets wrapped around substantially, one far larger leaves a sharp shadow and near-rectilinear travel. That test turns an old saying into arithmetic—a doorway is about a metre wide while audible sound runs from 17 m down to 1.7 cm, the same order, so you hear someone before you see them; visible light at 5×10⁻⁷ m is six orders smaller, so its shadow edge is crisp, and straight-line propagation itself is just the short-wavelength limit (see Rectilinear Propagation of Light, with the quantitative diffraction ledger in Interference & Diffraction). The same mechanism explains an everyday acoustic fact: sound speeds up with temperature, so on a warm day the upper air is faster and rays bend upward, carrying a shout poorly, whereas at night the ground cools first, the upper air is faster and rays curve back down, which is why distant traffic is audible late at night (see Speed of Sound for that temperature side). The original principle fixes wavefront geometry but never says how much energy goes each way; Fresnel added coherent superposition of the wavelets and Kirchhoff supplied the rigorous diffraction integral, making it the quantitatively usable Huygens–Fresnel principle. Today it is not an independent hypothesis but an equivalent representation of the solution of the wave equation—the fact that a spherical front's next envelope is again spherical holds for mechanical, electromagnetic and water waves alike. A page of history is worth keeping: Huygens used the wavelet picture in his 1690 Treatise on Light to explain reflection and refraction, facing off against Newton's corpuscles for over a century until Young's double slit of 1801 pushed the wave theory into the open, and the very same picture hands over the link between refractive index and light speed. Those chapters belong to Young's Double-Slit Experiment and the optics entries; what stays here is the construction itself—how a front nudges forward point by point—together with its bounds of use: a homogeneous medium, a known wave speed, and the wavelength-to-obstacle ratio setting how coarse the pattern is.

oneLiner: 两列频率相近的波叠加，强弱会周期性地起伏，起伏频率等于两频率之差。
oneLinerEn: Two waves of nearby frequencies add into a pulsation whose rate is their difference.
detail: 两列频率相近、振幅相仿、沿同一方向振动的波叠加，强弱会周期性地起伏，起伏的每秒次数即拍频 |f₁−f₂|。用和差化积看得最清楚：两式相加化为 2A cos(2π(Δf/2)t)·sin(2π f̄ t)，包络的数学频率只有差的一半，可“响一次”在每个包络周期里出现两次，所以听见的拍频恰好等于 f 之差——这个“一半与两倍互相抵消”的细节是本条最容易讲错的地方。拍是叠加造成的效果而非第三种波：介质中每一点仍同时参与两个频率的振动，只是合位移在交替放大与抵消；加强时能量聚在这里，减弱时挪到别处，总能量不变。听拍判音准极灵敏：音叉 256 与 259 赫兹同敲，每秒听见三次强弱；标准音 440 赫兹与一把 438 赫兹的弦对奏，拍频每秒两次，越准拍越慢，拍完全消失即已同频。钢琴调律比这更精一层：真琴弦因刚度而谐波略高，纯 2∶1 的八度反而听着“死”，调律师要按十二平均律故意留出每秒零点几拍的“活拍”，靠不同音程各自规定该留多快来判断音准——这门手艺叫拍频分律。工程侧，超声血流计与雷达测速把发射波与回波混频取差频，再靠差频与速度的比例读出流速或车速（多普勒本身的账在「多普勒效应」条，本条只讲“为什么要先混出一个低频差”）。近频叠加还是理解波包的入口：两列相近频率合成一个忽强忽弱的包，色散介质里这个包整体的移动速度与单色波的相速度不同，这正是群速度的雏形；想把它画出来，水波槽里两列近频波纹交叠即可看到缓慢游动的菱形网格，条纹本身既在时间上起伏也在空间上起伏。最后两处区分：与「驻波与共振」的分别是“同频相向”对“近频同向”——驻波的节与腹钉在空间不动，拍则是同一点上振幅随时间起伏；与两个音叉“共振驱动”的分别是拍需要两列波同时存在，缺一即无拍。频率相差太远就不再是拍而是两个独立音，人耳能分辨的差值下限约几赫兹以内才算“同音带拍”。
detailEn: Two waves of nearby frequencies and similar amplitudes travelling the same way add into a swell that rises and falls, and the number of beats each second is |f₁−f₂|. Sum-to-product makes it transparent: the pair becomes 2A cos(2π(Δf/2)t)·sin(2π f̄ t), so the envelope's mathematical frequency is only half the difference while each envelope cycle delivers two loud maxima—the 'half' and the 'double' cancel, and the audible beat rate comes out exactly equal to the frequency difference. That subtlety is where explanations most often slip. A beat is an effect of superposition, not a third wave: every particle still takes part in both original oscillations while the resultant displacement alternately amplifies and cancels; energy gathers at a loud moment and moves elsewhere at a quiet one, with the total unchanged. Ears are uncannily sensitive to beats: strike a 256 Hz fork against a 259 Hz one and you hear three pulsations a second; bow a 438 Hz string against standard 440 Hz and you hear two, the beat slowing as the gap closes and vanishing at unison. Piano tuning goes one layer finer: real strings are stiff, so their harmonics sit slightly above exact multiples, and a pure 2∶1 octave sounds dead, so tuners deliberately leave a fraction of a beat per second according to the equal-tempered scale, judging each interval by the beat rate it is supposed to keep—the craft is voiced tuning by beats. On the engineering side, ultrasonic blood-flow meters and radar speed guns mix the emitted wave with the echo and read the difference frequency, whose ratio to speed then gives flow or velocity (the Doppler account itself is in the Doppler Effect entry; what belongs here is only why mixing down to a low difference frequency helps). Two nearby frequencies are also the doorway to wave packets: their sum is a slowly pulsing envelope, and in a dispersive medium that envelope travels at a speed different from the phase speed of either monochromatic component—the seed of group velocity. Draw it in a ripple tank: two trains of nearly equal frequency overlap into a drifting rhombic grid, undulating in time and in space at once. Two final separations. From Standing Waves & Resonance the difference is same-frequency counter-travelling versus near-frequency co-travelling—standing waves pin nodes and antinodes in space, beats make one point pulse in time. From resonant driving by a tuning fork the difference is that a beat needs both waves present simultaneously; remove one and the pulsation disappears. Push the frequencies far apart and it is no longer a beat but two distinct tones: the ear only reads them as one tone-with-beats while the gap stays within a few hertz.
